description: Underworld API for Minecraft mods on NeoForge

mods.name: U-API
mods.description: Shared services, retained UI, HUD, world overlays, networking, diagnostics, instances, and integration contracts for the U-API ecosystem.

releases.notes:
- Promoted the Minecraft 26.2 port to a stable release after the beta line passed compatibility
  and lifecycle validation.
- Added working project and issue-tracker links to the metadata shown by NeoForge mod lists.
- Contains no API, gameplay or persisted-data changes from 3.0.0-beta.5.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 26.2
- Loader: NeoForge
- Java: 25
